meta.name: linkedin-ads-audiences
meta.description: Build and manage LinkedIn Ads audiences, targeting, exclusions, and ABM account lists. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn ad targeting, audience setup, ICP targeting on LinkedIn, exclusion lists, ABM targeting, company lists vs contact lists, audience sizes, remarketing audiences, or Audience Expansion. Triggers on "LinkedIn targeting", "LinkedIn audience", "exclusion list", "ABM targeting", "company list", "remarketing audience", "audience size", "Audience Expansion". Do NOT use for bidding/budget questions (use bidding) or creative (use creative/copy).

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在LinkedIn上投放广告并需要精细管理受众
copy.tagline_en: Manage LinkedIn ad audiences and targeting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run LinkedIn ads and need to manage audiences precisely

howto.what: Claude帮你构建LinkedIn广告受众：定义理想客户画像（行业、公司规模、职位），选择定位方式（职位或职能+资历），设置排除名单（竞争对手、客户等），配置再营销或ABM公司列表，并建议使用ColdIQ数据源。
howto.when: 当用户询问LinkedIn广告定位、受众设置、排除列表，或提到“LinkedIn targeting”、“LinkedIn audience”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请帮我设置LinkedIn广告的排除名单。
say.note: Claude会引导你创建排除竞争对手和客户的名单。

say.text: 如何用公司列表做ABM定位？
say.note: Claude会指导你上传公司列表并添加职位和地点。

say.text: 我的ICP是科技公司CEO，怎么定位？

howto.what_en: Claude helps you build LinkedIn ad audiences: define ICP (industry, company size, titles), choose targeting approach (job title or function+seniority), set up exclusion lists (competitors, customers, etc.), configure remarketing or ABM company lists, and recommends using ColdIQ data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks about LinkedIn ad targeting, audience setup, exclusion lists, or mentions 'LinkedIn targeting', 'LinkedIn audience' etc.

say_en.text: Help me set up exclusion lists for LinkedIn ads.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through excluding competitors and customers.

say_en.text: How do I use company lists for ABM targeting?
My ICP is tech company CEOs, how to target?
